question: Which selected native command boundaries distinguish army disbanding from unit deletion, and do they identify the reported loaded-fleet Gold credit?

scope.boundary: Selected mapper words, two dispatcher cases, the disband helper and three exact same-low-immediate discrimination windows. The functions that contain the candidate windows were not established; six is a conservative upper charge, not six complete function bodies. Unused neighboring words provide no semantics. No whole cargo traversal, refund or value producer, UI input route or completed helper-call contract is included.

dependencies.use: Command-type-to-debug-label mapper input and limited table identity.
Accepted numeric dispatcher targets and separate command delivery and authority limits.
Accepted 0x82D02390 mode 0 unit-removal semantics, including carried units; removal is not a refund contract.
Accepted player Gold reserve 0x830ED544+4*p without a sole-writer claim.
Closed modeled-reference negative does not exclude split-address native accesses.
Covers the separate selected sale producer, linked-factor collection, carrier multiplier and Gold-command credit.

selectedCommands.armyDisband: Mapper type 11 cell 0x82CD544C selects 0x82CD55B8, which returns the DisbandA label at 0x82156C48. Its accepted dispatcher target 0x82CE02A0 calls 0x82D13520(r31,r15), then clears a selected unit flag and completes through 0x82CE16AC.
selectedCommands.helper: 0x82D13550 clears addressed unit byte +4. The helper runs two iterations, calling creator 0x82D11750 only when the type is not minus one, then copies selected rank, movement and status fields and invokes root virtual +0x1B8. Creator return-1 handling, the callback effects, whether the relevant state stays valid, and the actual resulting units remain unresolved. These inspected words identify a creation or copy operation, not the reported sale payout.
selectedCommands.unitDeletion: Mapper type 16 cell 0x82CD5460 selects 0x82CD55F4, which returns DelUnit at 0x82156C78. Its accepted dispatcher target 0x82CE1354 passes r3=r31,r4=r15,r5=0 to 0x82D02390 at 0x82CE1360, then completes through 0x82CE16AC. This links the selected command to accepted unit removal, not to an explicit player-reserve credit.
selectedCommands.qualification: Neither command label establishes the human sale input, the carrier and passenger valuation or a Gold transaction. This read set of commands and hints supplies no proved fleet or cargo multiplier. The disband helper's unresolved virtual effects prevent a whole-call-tree no-credit claim.

saleHintLead.identity: Defined UI sale-hint text is at 0x82125A14. Its decoded materializer search emitted zero matches and its aligned full-pointer search emitted zero; both read sets are closed negatives that cover only those searches.
saleHintLead.rawDiscriminator: A raw addi-immediate 0x5A14 inventory with mask 0xFC00FFFF emitted three candidates. 0x8260A308 and 0x8260A52C use high 0x8208, so they are not the selected hint. 0x82E58E2C and 0x82E58E34 instead form 0x82125A14 in r4 and call 0x82E6A430 at 0x82E58E38, then transfer the returned value toward 0x82E59424. The callee and actual UI action remain unexpanded.
saleHintLead.coverage: At 0x82E58E34 the canonical function-neighborhood query reports no containing function and no instructions in its selected window. Raw native words support the local materializer; the incomplete listing supplies no input-dispatch, helper or complete-body claim.
saleHintLead.remaining: Link the actual hint and UI receiver to the selected producer in unit-sale-refund-value, keeping the current unit and player identity. The hint's presence alone does not establish that action or refund.

closedReserveSearch.result: The query reached its 8-match display cap. The displayed candidates were not expanded or assigned reserve semantics. This form is closed as capped output and cannot prove an exhaustive writer inventory or absence of another source.

currentEvidence.method: Serialized foreground read-only Ghidra queries and exact big-endian PowerPC decoding, checked against the supported flat image; no recompiled copy of a function and no runtime was read.

guards: Do not treat DisbandA or UnitKill as a proved sale or refund producer.
Do not divide every refund by 3 or infer passenger value from the carrier's army or fleet flag.
Keep American rush discounts, cargo army state, carrier fleet state and actual reserve changes distinct.
Static command and hint identity does not reproduce the reported single-passenger or ten-passenger payout.
falsification: Different command table, case or helper words falsify the selected boundaries. A link from sale input to credit, with the cargo identities kept unchanged, can establish or reject the reported multiplier and selects the next valuation investigation.
conclusion: The selected army-disband command performs unit creation and copy work only when its conditions hold; the separate unit-delete command reaches native removal. A raw sale-hint materializer is identified despite the incomplete canonical listing. The separate unit-sale-refund-value topic covers the cargo valuation and the link to the credit; hint and input delivery and an implemented resale correction remain unverified.
